title: Degreewise quasi-coherence of pseudo-coherent RHom
statement: For a pseudo-coherent K and bounded-below quasi-coherent L, the n-th cohomology sheaf of RHom(K,L) is quasi-coherent for every integer n.

proof.text: Unpack IsPseudoCoherent to obtain a neighbourhood U_x and bounded-above finite-free model P_x at every point. Restrict L; the exact restriction/homology comparison preserves its lower bound and quasi-coherent cohomology. Choose a bounded-below K-injective representative I of the restricted L by the bounded-below injective-resolution theorem. Its cohomology is quasi-coherent by the derived representative and homology comparison isomorphisms.

Let m be a strict lower bound for I and let c=m-n-1. Form the explicit stupid truncation E of P_x below c. It is bounded and finite free: retained terms are isomorphic to P_x terms; discarded terms are zero and hence free of rank zero. In each degree q=n-1,n,n+1, precomposition with E into P_x gives an isomorphism on each internal Hom factor. For p>=c the source map is invertible; for p<c, p+q<m and both Hom factors are zero by Mathlib Functor.map_isZero applied to internal Hom in its target variable, using a locally proved PreservesZeroMorphisms instance (postcomposition with zero). The product universal properties prove the comparison in each of these three degrees is an isomorphism. Mathlib ShortComplex.isIso_homologyMap_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono gives its cohomology isomorphism in degree n. These calculations are proved by private helpers in the delivered module.

Apply finiteFree_homComplex_qc_cohomology to E and I. Transport through the proved truncation cohomology isomorphism to H^n(Hom(P_x,I)). The K-injective computation of derivedInternalHom identifies this with the restricted derived internal Hom; derivedInternalHom_restrict_open and the exact homology/restriction comparison identify it with H^n(RHom(K,L)) over U_x. Apply IsQuasicoherent.of_coversTop to the cover U_x, with coverage proved from x in U_x.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0A6H (1): degreewise finite-column reduction using a bounded-below K-injective target, the Hom-complex formula in Tag 08I5, and local quasi-coherence.

theorem rhom_supported_quasiCoherent_pseudo_part_qc_cohomology
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (K L : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (hL : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X L)
    (hK : Scheme.IsPseudoCoherent X K) (hGE : ∃ a : ℤ, L.IsGE a)
    (n : ℤ) :
    ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj
      ((derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.toRingedSpace)
        X.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj (op K, L))).IsQuasicoherent
